about_the_game:
🐧 Spiny & Chilly

Spiny & Chilly is a 3D platformer collectathon inspired by genre classics like Banjo-Kazooie, Super Mario 64, Super Mario Galaxy, and modern hits like A Hat in Time. Take control of Chilly, a goofy, ice-obsessed penguin, and his sarcastic hedgehog companion Spiny, as they set off on a whimsical journey to recover the stolen ice blocks from the evil Polar Bear King.

🎮 Core Gameplay

  • Explore vibrant, themed worlds packed with secrets and collectibles.

  • Master satisfying movement mechanics like wall jumps, double jumps, sliding, and surfing.

  • Interact with gameplay elements like bounce platforms, gravity shifts, and more.

  • Collect tons of unique items—especially the precious ice blocks scattered throughout each level.

🌍 Worlds to Discover

Join Spiny & Chilly as they venture through:

  • A meteor-crashed valley turned mining colony run by mole engineers.

  • A haunted harbor plagued by ghost ships.

  • A floating island inhabited by brilliant bird scientists.

  • More to come!

Each level is handcrafted with its own theme, challenges, and quirky characters.
